SELECT AVG(group_avg_compression) as overall_avg_compression, AVG(group_avg_size_per_min) as overall_avg_size_per_min FROM (SELECT AVG(s.pressratio) as group_avg_compression, AVG(CASE WHEN s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin > 0 THEN s.gbsize / s.spanmin ELSE NULL END) as group_avg_size_per_min FROM scans s JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE s.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.typesite)
-- Result: average compression ratio = 5.455392405063291, average size-per-minute = 0.3855274878545944
